recentItems.title: The Amazing Race's Phil Keoghan Reveals His Secret Hidden Talent! | CBS Pop Quiz
recentItems.description:
Phil Keoghan of The Amazing Race answers rapid-fire trivia and fan questions while popping confetti balloons in a fun pop quiz. He reveals his favorite game strategies, reflects on 25 years of hosting, and shares a surprising hidden talent.

The Amazing Race airs Wednesdays on CBS and streaming on Paramount+!

THE AMAZING RACE is a multiple Emmy Award-winning reality series hosted by Emmy Award-nominated host Phil Keoghan, where teams of two embark on a race around the world. At every destination, each team must compete in a series of challenges, some mental and some physical, and only when the tasks are completed will they learn of their next location. Teams that are the farthest behind will gradually be eliminated as the contest progresses, with the first team to arrive at the final destination winning THE AMAZING RACE and the $1 million prize.

Key Questions Answered
* Does Phil Keoghan prefer to U-turn another team or be U-turned? 
* What is Phil Keoghan’s favorite color? 
* How does The Amazing Race host feel about watching early season episodes? 
* What is Phil Keoghan’s most memorable moment after hosting over 400 episodes? 
* What secret hidden talent does Phil Keoghan have that fans don't know about? 

Timestamps/Chapters
0:00 Balloon Pop Quiz Challenge Intro
0:12 Game Strategy: U-Turn Decision
0:29 Favorite Color & Watching Old Episodes
0:49 Phil's Most Memorable Race Moment
1:18 Revealing Phil Keoghan's Hidden Talent

Play-by-Play Overview
Phil Keoghan kicks off the interactive pop quiz by explaining the rules: popping balloons filled with colored confetti determines which color ball he draws to receive a random trivia question.

First up, Phil draws a blue prompt asking whether he would rather U-turn a team or be U-turned. He enthusiastically chooses U-turning another team, declaring that dramatic strategy is what makes for great television.

Next, Phil answers quick personal questions, confirming his favorite color is blue and reflecting on what it feels like to rewatch early The Amazing Race episodes. He jokes that watching old footage serves as a time-lapse of him getting older, moving from the days of standard-definition television to crisp high definition.

Phil then pops another balloon to answer a deep question about his most memorable moment from the franchise. After 25 years, over 400 episodes, almost one million miles traveled, and more than 100 countries visited, he pinpoints Season 1 when he lifted his hand and said "Go!" for the very first time.

Finally, Phil wraps up the pop quiz by revealing a surprising personal secret: he has played the violin since age three, attended music school as a child, and still plays one of the world's most difficult instruments today.

ETERNALLY YOURS is a family comedy centered around Charles (Ed Weeks) and Liz (Allegra Edwards) – a vampire couple whose once-passionate romance has devolved into a pulseless marriage after 500 years together. Living in present-day Seattle with their oddball coven, they’ve settled into an eternal rut – until their daughter’s earnest human boyfriend unexpectedly enters their lives and forces them to confront whether their love can survive forever…or if forever is a life sentence.

For over two decades, SURVIVOR has defined reality television, evolving from a bold social experiment into a groundbreaking global phenomenon. Across dozens of unforgettable seasons, castaways have been marooned in remote locations, forced to rely on their wits, adaptability, and resilience to outwit, outplay, and outlast one another. Driven by complex strategic alliances, high-stakes challenges, and surprise twists, the series is a masterclass in human psychology and physical endurance. Hosted by Emmy winner Jeff Probst, SURVIVOR remains the ultimate celebration of legacy and strategy, where players battle for the title of Sole Survivor and the $1 million prize.

Key Questions Answered
* How did Jeff Probst surprise Jaren Lewison? 
* Would Jaren Lewison ever compete on Survivor? 
* How far does Jaren Lewison think he would make it on Survivor? 
* What advice did Jeff Probst give Jaren Lewison about Hollywood and Survivor strategy? 

Timestamps/Chapters
00:00 - Jaren Lewison on his love for Survivor
00:37 - Jeff Probst sends a surprise video message
01:30 - Jaren's reaction and response to Jeff Probst

Play-by-Play Overview
* Loving the Game: Jaren Lewison introduces himself, talks about his role as Max on Eternally Yours, and shares his deep passion for Survivor. He reflects on the show's unpredictable gameplay and speculates that he might reach the post-merge stage before getting voted out. 
* A Message From Jeff: Survivor host Jeff Probst appears in a surprise video to congratulate Jaren on joining a legacy team, drawing clever comparisons between navigating network television dynamics and playing Survivor. He encourages Jaren to savor his achievement and officially invites him to play the game, citing writer Mike White's successful run on the show. 
* Pure Disbelief: Jaren reacts to the message in shock and awe, expressing gratitude for Jeff's words and noting how jealous his friends are going to be.

CIA focuses on a clandestine CIA/FBI task force where secretive and roguish CIA Agent Colin Glass finds himself teamed up with by-the-book FBI Special Agent Bill Goodman. The duo work together on covert operations in New York, uncovering international plots, terrorist cells and geopolitical secrets. Also on the team is Deputy Chief of Station Nikki Reynard and CIA Analyst Gina Gosian. On CIA, Bill continues to learn the rules of this murky world on the fly as Colin leads him deeper into spy games where only one thing is clear – their work keeps America safe, even if no one will ever know what they did in the shadows.

Now Bode walks as a free man as he continues his journey toward redemption in his small hometown with Cal Fire.

recentItems.title: Marshals: Season 2 Episode 1 | Full Episode | All Hat No Cattle | CBS
recentItems.description:
Kayce Dutton goes rogue in Bighorn, Wyoming to rescue his kidnapped son, Tate, uncovering a massive cattle Ponzi scheme run by land-grabber Tom Weaver.

Watch on CBS | Stream on Paramount+ #MarshalsCBS
Follow Marshals on Instagram HERE: https://www.instagram.com/marshalscbs
Follow Marshals on TikTok HERE: https://www.tiktok.com/@marshalscbs
Like Marshals on Facebook HERE: https://www.facebook.com/marshalscbs
Watch more Marshals HERE: https://www.paramountplus.com/shows/marshals

MARSHALS stars Luke Grimes as Kayce Dutton. With the Yellowstone Ranch behind him, Dutton joins an elite unit of U.S. Marshals, combining his skills as a cowboy and Navy SEAL to bring range justice to Montana, where he and his teammates must balance family, duty and the high psychological cost that comes with serving as the last line of defense in the region’s war on violence.

Key Questions Answered
* How does Kayce Dutton discover that his son Tate has been taken hostage by Tom Weaver's operatives? 
* What financial crime is Tom Weaver hiding behind his cattle operation and the East Camp land grab? 
* How do the U.S. Marshals connect the attacks on Chairman Rainwater to Weaver's mercenary force? 
* Why does Dolly Weaver turn on her father during the high-stakes standoff in Wyoming? 
* How does Kayce rescue Tate without blowing up his team's official operation? 

Timestamps/Chapters
00:00 - Recap & The Threat to East Camp
01:09 - Kayce Dutton Traumatized After House Attack
03:46 - Attorney Stan Cobb Delivers Weaver’s Extortion Ultimatum
06:16 - Marshals Ambush Mercenaries & Recover Encrypted Phones
08:12 - Kayce Confronts Dolly Weaver & Forces Her Cooperation
11:05 - Marshals Connect Mercenary Leader Jed Burrows to Weaver
14:00 - Kayce Agrees to Exchange East Camp for Tate in Wyoming
17:00 - Marshals Uncover Weaver’s 9-Figure Ghost-Cow Ponzi Scheme
24:30 - Kayce and Dolly Enter Weaver's Wiretapped Compound
27:00 - Standoff: Weaver Betrays Dolly & Demands Kayce’s Execution
33:30 - Tactical Shootout: Marshals Raid the Wyoming Ranch
36:00 - Final Confrontation: Dolly’s Death & Weaver’s Arrest
38:30 - Aftermath: Kayce Brings Tate Home to Montana

Step-by-Step Overview
1. Extortion & Kidnapping: Attorney Stan Cobb confronts Kayce Dutton, demanding he sign over East Camp in exchange for his son Tate, who is being held at Tom Weaver's Wyoming ranch. 
2. Forcing Leverage: Kayce takes Weaver's daughter, Dolly, as collateral and forces her to guide him through Weaver's heavily armed Bighorn compound. 
3. Uncovering the Fraud: The Marshals investigate Weaver's cattle operation, discovering fake meatpacking invoices and revealing a multi-million-dollar ghost-cattle Ponzi scheme that Weaver is killing to cover up. 
4. Linking the Mercenaries: Intelligence identifies ranch foreman Jed Burrows as a court-martialed Canadian Task Force operative leading the mercenary attacks on East Camp and Chairman Rainwater. 
5. The Compound Standoff: Kayce surrenders the East Camp deed to secure Tate, but Weaver attempts a double-cross, ordering his mercenaries to execute Kayce and frame it as a fishing accident. 
6. Tactical Rescue: The U.S. Marshals trace Weaver's private flight logs to Bighorn, launching a tactical raid on the ranch that neutralizes the mercenary force and frees Tate. 
7. Resolution: Following a fatal confrontation that claims Dolly's life, Weaver is arrested, ending the land-grab conspiracy and allowing Kayce to bring Tate safely back to Montana.
